stem: A pump alarm clears after an authorized reset but returns twice during the same shift. What is the best Technician II response?
choices: Keep resetting it until the shift ends
Treat the repeated recurrence as evidence of an unresolved fault, document the pattern and affected scope, and escalate according to procedure
rationale: Repeated recurrence after a permitted reset indicates the problem is not resolved. Preserving the pattern and escalating is safer and more useful than repeated resets or unauthorized repair.
